cover_admission.scope: raster_bytes: boolean union raster(s); working_bytes: 1-D coordinate scratch + row-tiled footprint temporaries (float64 distance + bool mask). P-sized index arrays are reported as index_bytes by measure_cover and scale with the population, not the grid

cover_measurement.boundary_note: finite closed non-periodic domain: canopies are clipped at the domain edge for cover and never wrap; exclusion placement treats the edge as a hard boundary. A periodic MAPLE raster interpretation would change both cover and overlap and must be requalified by the adapter, not assumed equal
cover_measurement.definition: per-group projected union ground cover clipped to the finite non-periodic domain (same-group overlap counted once; cross-group overlap counted in each group); nominal = sum of unclipped crown areas / domain area
cover_measurement.error_basis: midpoint sampling at resolution dx/s: each circle boundary is resolved to about one raster cell, relative error per circle ~ resolution / radius; sampled, not analytic

derived.ordering_convention: large_canopy_first: all candidates sorted by descending diameter (stable tie-break: species order, then sample order) and placed sequentially with global canopy exclusion

diameter_distribution.rule: sigma^2 = ln(1 + std^2/mean^2), mu = ln(mean) - sigma^2/2
sigma^2 = ln(1 + std^2/mean^2), mu = ln(mean) - sigma^2/2

generation_config_note: accepted SOURCE configuration: generate_population(catalog, generation_config, surface=...) with the same catalog/surface replays this run exactly
ordering_convention: large_canopy_first: all candidates sorted by descending diameter (stable tie-break: species order, then sample order) and placed sequentially with global canopy exclusion
placement: large-canopy-first sequential uniform proposals with global cross-species canopy exclusion (roots may overlap); complete re-placement after each count correction; sparse hashed bins, not all pairs; not a Poisson process

rng.draw_order: per species batch: diameters, ages; then per placement pass, per candidate in descending size order, per proposal: x (uniform), y (uniform)
